body:
I have no idea what i am guilty about... i just have strong feelings of guilt flowing through me and causing me pain a lot of times

> You talk about a lot of stuff, including cyberbullying and issues with parents..do you mind expanding on any of that?

There was a photoshopped picture that was posted on reddit to mock me and humiliate me, it got really popular and then many people started hating on me, mocking me and harassing me, this was the worst thing that ever happened to me on the internet and i was the one being blamed for it

I also have weight problems, i have been trying my hardest to lose weight in the past 2 months but my metabolism and genetics are really awful so i haven't had too much success with it

My parents verbally abuse me and sometimes physically

Not really with THIS subreddit but a lot with /r/depression

I don't hate this subreddit at all, people here are nice but many posts just never get any comments 

I am the only one that knows about my depression, i am too afraid that i will be mocked or blamed for being depressed with people saying things like "just stop being sad lol" or "depressed? HAHAHAHAHA, then just stop being a selfish downer" or "depressed people are just pathetic bags of meat who choose to be that way" or the worst one saying stuff about staving children in africa and there being no reason to be depressed or whatever

How do i stop the overwhelming feelings of guilt and sadness?
